description: Publisher independently invokes trusted verification before promotion and retains verifier failure evidence

cases.description: The production publisher rejects a forged passing decision using the real trusted verifier and retains a Failed receipt bound to the run, manifest, and bundle
The production publisher creates an immutable run and verifies exact content read-back against an isolated local bare Git remote
Promotion without the complete trusted verification and integration evidence is rejected before writing any publication receipt
A rejected archive push leaves a Failed receipt and cannot claim publication success
A successful archive push followed by remote read-back failure leaves a Failed receipt and cannot claim retrievable success
An unreachable archive remote retains a Failed receipt before publisher exit
Failure to create the immutable archive commit retains a Failed receipt and cannot claim success
Trusted verifier and integration metadata authorize the production publisher to archive a candidate and advance the accepted index in the same retrievable archive commit
A passing candidate with an unsupported push event cannot write a publication receipt or advance the accepted index
A passing candidate with an integration base different from its measured target cannot write a publication receipt or advance the accepted index
